enchantments.tooltip: +11 Enhancement Bonus: +11 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Insightful Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Persuasion: This item gives a +3 competency bonus to all Charisma based skills.
Haste Guard: When you are hit by enemies, there is a chance you will be Hasted, quickening your attack and movement speed.

Exceptional Fortification (+50%): This item produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a +50% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and the damage is instead rolled normally. This ability is considered an Insight bonus when determining stacking with other sources of fortification

Greater Nimbleness: This suit of armor looks much less restrictive than others of its type. A suit of armor that has this property has a maximum Dexterity bonus 2 higher than normal, and its armor check penalty is reduced by 4.

enchantments.text: Upgradeable - Primary Augment (Yellow Augment Slot or Blue Augment Slot)
enchantments.tooltip: Upgradeable - Primary Augment: This item can be upgraded to contain a Yellow, Blue or Red (weapons and shields only) augment. Bring this item to the Fountain of Necrotic Might outside the Black Mausoleum and combine it with Item:Epic Tapestry Shreds to upgrade the item.Yellow and ColorlessBlue and Colorless

Upgradeable - Secondary Augment: This item can be upgraded to contain a Green, Orange (weapons and shields only) or Purple (weapons and shields only) augment. Bring this item to the Fountain of Necrotic Might outside the Black Mausoleum and combine it with Item:Masterwork Tapestry Shreds to upgrade the item.Blue, Green, Yellow, and Colorless
Unbreakable Adamancy: This item is part of the Unbreakable Adamancy set.When two items from this set are equipped, you gain a +5 Luck bonus to PRR and MRR.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
